climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A state whose wine industry grew after 1981, when the legislature relaxed Prohibition-era limits. It has four AVAs: Central Delaware Valley, Warren Hills, Outer Coastal Plain and Cape May Peninsula. In 2012 it had 1,082 acres of grapes.
